'''Imperial Commandos, '''also known as '''Sith [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]],''' were [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==History==
During the [[Great Galactic War]] after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], two Imperial commandos ambushed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Satele Shan]] on a transport ship but were slain in the process. Their deaths were constituted as a violation of the peace treaty between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] according to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[SP-99]].

==Description==
[[File:Imperial_Commandos_on_Makeb.png|left|thumb|Imperial Commandos on [[Makeb]]]]
Imperial commandos were trained and used by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] in many operations to undermine [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and assassinate high priority targets. Notable Imperial Commandos include [[Cormun (Imperial Army)|Cormun]], [[Kalmic]] and the [[Shadow Captain]]. Imperial commandos wore a heavily armored uniform with a helmet very different to that of a [[Imperial soldier|standard Imperial soldier]]. Most Imperial Commandos wore light [[Color/Legends|grey]] and white armor. However, [[Korriban regiment]] members wore red armor.
